name: T.A.L.O
source:
He thought he'd be living a carefree life once he moved to Tokyo alone.

He couldn't have been more wrong.

His encounters with four strange girls seem inconsequential, until they become his neighbors.

Then a mysterious assassin targets him, determined to claim his life.

He got a lot more than he bargained for when he met those girls.

For they're the Four Horsewomen of the Apocalypse

...and they've chosen him to decide whether or not the Apocalypse should begin.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1071877822/talo-episode-one]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
他以为自己一个人搬到东京后就会过上无忧无虑的生活。

他大错特错了。

他与四个陌生女孩的遭遇似乎无关紧要，直到她们成为了他的邻居。

然后一名神秘刺客瞄准了他，决心要夺走他的生命。

当他遇到那些女孩时，他得到的比他预想的要多得多。

因为她们是天启四骑士

……他们选择他来决定世界末日是否应该开始。

[来自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1071877822/talo-episode-one]Kickstarter[/url]]
